name: BBA
title: BBA — Bachelor of Business Administration
intro: The management degree path: Class 12 prerequisites, entrance exams, three or four years of study, internships and MBA or job routes.

phases.title: Class 11–12: any stream
phases.summary: BBA accepts every stream; Maths helps for finance and analytics electives.
points: Choose any stream in Class 11–12; Commerce students find the subjects familiar, but Science and Arts students are equally eligible.
Many colleges require 50% in Class 12.
Build communication and basic maths skills.
Start following business news and case studies.

phases.title: Entrance exams and application cycle
phases.summary: CUET-UG for central universities, plus institute-level tests.
points: Common exams: CUET-UG, IPMAT (for integrated courses), NPAT (NMIMS), SET (Symbiosis), AIMA UGAT, and state tests like MAH-BBA CET.
Applications usually open from January to May; tests are held between February and June.
After the test, colleges conduct interviews, group discussions and personal interviews.
Apply to a mix of top-choice and safe colleges.
facts: CUET-UG, NPAT, SET, IPMAT, MAH-BBA CET

phases.title: Six semesters of core and electives
phases.summary: Management, marketing, finance, HR and operations.
points: Year 1 builds fundamentals: Principles of Management, Business Economics, Accounting, Business Communication and Statistics.
Year 2 covers Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations and Business Law.
Year 3 covers electives, strategy and a project; under NEP some colleges offer a fourth honours year.
Case study discussions, presentations and group projects are core to teaching.

phases.title: Internships and live projects
phases.summary: Summer internships build your CV and often lead to job offers.
points: Most BBA programmes require a summer internship after Year 1 or 2.
Look for roles in marketing, sales, HR, finance and operations teams.
Join clubs, enter case competitions and undertake a final-year project.
Add skills such as Excel, Power BI, digital marketing or SQL.

phases.title: After BBA: jobs or MBA
phases.summary: Enter the job market or prepare for a management master’s.
points: Jobs: management trainee, sales or marketing executive, HR associate, business analyst.
MBA entrance: CAT, XAT, CMAT, MAT, GMAT and SNAP.
Alternatives: CFA, CA, CS, or a master’s in management or analytics.
Government jobs and banking exams are also open to graduates.
